applicability.jurisdiction_or_standard_context: Primarily UK/Eurocode-oriented SteelConstruction.info guidance, corroborated by public AISC/NSBA steel behavior material. Concept guidance only.

claims.text: Steel bending-member checks depend on bending action, section class or section properties, and the relevant resistance model.
Beam interpretation should keep bending, shear, torsion, and axial-force interaction distinct before combining them in a check.
Steel member behavior knowledge is useful for explaining check drivers, but final adequacy still belongs to a scoped design check.

limitations: No formulas, resistance factors, or Eurocode/AISC design procedure are encoded here.
The card does not decide whether a member is laterally restrained.

pages_used: Member design: Bending, Shear, Torsion, Bending and axial force
Steel Bridge Design Handbook Chapter 4 landing page

summary: Steel bending-member cards should explain which actions and assumptions matter, while leaving final resistance evaluation to scoped checks.
